lina (sales): Quick sync 10: ACME Health wants SOC 2 excerpt + bridge letter and mutual NDA before starting a 2-week Dedicated POC. They also need a scoped API key (48h) and read-only console (24h). Can legal/security confirm what we can hand over quickly? cc @marc (legal) @arjun (security)

 marc (legal): We can send a redacted SOC 2 excerpt (opinion, scope, control families). No workpapers or control IDs. I can prepare a mutual NDA in DocuSign + an adapted bridge letter. Will watermark the excerpt and include "REDACTED FOR CONFIDENTIALITY." Can deliver the packet EOD next business day once you confirm mutual NDA.

 arjun (security): Ok. For access: we can issue a time-limited API key (48h) scoped to the project and a 24h read-only console role. If they request logs with payloads we need product-risk signoff for PII redaction. All disclosures logged to disclosure system.

 claire (eng): On Dedicated infra we'll reserve a small pool and pin the runtime to v2.1.0-optimized. Need a JIRA with authorized emails and billing contact. We'll disable autoscale for the POC window.

 disclosure-bot: POLICY: Per SH-3, external SOC 2 excerpts must exclude auditor workpapers and internal identifiers. Create disclosure record when excerpt uploaded.

 lina (sales): Customer: acme-health.com. Users: maya@acme-health.com, tom@acme-health.com. I'll send DocuSign mutual NDA now and ask about test data (PII or synthetic). DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/poctemp (will update with signed link).

 marc (legal): Received. I'll prepare NDA + bridge letter + redacted excerpt and attach once signed.

 arjun (security): Standby to provision after signed NDA and disclosure record. ETA ~24 hours after both.

 lina (sales): Thanks everyone 64f. Will post update when signed.
